subject_name: Aircraft Husbandry, Corrosion Prevention and Surface Protection
topic: Introductions to various standards BS, AS, DTD, MIL, AN, NAS, close tolerance, unified etc.

specific_objectives: 25.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the use of various standards, identification of bolts, nuts, safety methods and maintenance of cables.

Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of standard prefixes on sample fastener tags; Instructor supervision on correct identification of BS vs AN markings.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of using standardized fasteners in aircraft construction?
Why is it critical to distinguish between British Standard (BS) and American National Standard (AN) fasteners?
Can you list three common standard organizations used in aviation maintenance?

summary_questions: Explain the difference between an AN fastener and a NAS fastener in terms of application.
Why must a technician verify the standard type before installing a bolt in a critical structural area?
How does the 'close tolerance' designation affect the selection of replacement fasteners?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the identification markings of BS and AN fasteners to be used in the next lesson on bolt identification.
